AssetTimesheet.name: AssetTimesheet
AssetTimesheet.description: Represents a junction between an asset and a time sheet or time sheet entry that records all vehicles and heavy equipment used by a technician during a job.

Asset.description: Specifies the asset used to complete a time sheet or a time sheet entry.

TimeSheetEntry.description: Specifies the time sheet entry associated with the asset.

TimeSheet.description: Specifies the time sheet associated with the asset.
